messages.content: Please look up alice’s contact details and verify her employee record, then check for a meeting room for at least 6 people at 14:00 on 2025-09-15 and schedule “Quarterly Planning Sync” from 2025-09-15 14:00 to 2025-09-15 15:00 with alice@company.com and bob@company.com. After that, send Alice a high-priority app alert saying, “Your meeting has been scheduled and the room is being prepared.” Then scan the living_room devices, identify the smart lock, check the status of the light with device ID light_living, turn that light on, and set its brightness to 70%. Finally, create a snapshot of /shared/meeting-prep named meeting_prep_snapshot and send Alice a high-priority app notification.
